script.description: 从纯文本正文中提取前150字摘要到 content_head
script.source: if (ctx.containsKey('html_content') && ctx.html_content != null) { String text = ctx.html_content; ctx.content_head = text.length() <= 150 ? text : text.substring(0, 150); }
